important_findings: 入宅 is not merely a modern label: it is attested in the embedded 事類總集 material preserved in XJBF volumes 34–35.
That discovery does not make 入宅 identical to the v11 official event label 移徙.
The embedded source explicitly describes work completion before selecting a later entry/return-fire time, but this traditional sequence is not a substitute for modern legal acceptance.
宅經 supplies genuine 安門 spatial terminology, while its Huangdi attribution remains pseudepigraphic according to Siku.
